faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Dibrugarh District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Dibrugarh District Court Recruitment 2026 is 31 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the eligibility criteria for the Office Peon post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Office Peon post, candidates must have successfully completed Class VIII standard examination. This is the primary educational qualification required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is between a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 40 years. Age relaxation is provided for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for Dibrugarh District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Dibrugarh District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the advertised posts primarily involves a Viva-Voce. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in this stage.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are available in this recruitment drive. These vacancies are for the posts of Office Peon, Day Chowkidar, and Night Chowkidar.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in the Pay Band of Rs. 12000 – 52000 with a Grade Pay of Rs. 3900 per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Dibrugarh District Court Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Dibrugarh District Court, which is https://dibrugarh.dcourts.gov.in/.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents, including a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational certificates, along with the filled application form.
